html: My issue wasn't with a return to Japanese media being marketed to Americans, it was with what would be our grandkids generation caring at all about re-re-remakes and adaptation of media we liked when we were kids. I suspect by 2070, what we love will be out of style and we'll have to accept that the culture is chaning. Its why I started making up content past WWIII (I let Steve King go because he's a modern master of his genre).
